title: Perfect design
text: I have belonged to this for over a year. My husband has thoroughly enjoyed having a new shirt every month he is such a Star Trek person but to be honest the last couple of shirts were not very good quality and the pictures on them were not in my opinion very good I was considering letting the subscription go but now the last two shirts that I’ve received have been great so please understand in order to keep people keep up with good quality and great pictures
label: positive
